description: This file defines utility functions and classes for managing trace models, including handling actions, contexts, sources, and event sorting within a trace viewer application.

classes.name: MultiTraceModel
classes.description: Represents a comprehensive model of a trace, including actions, events, sources, and related metadata.

methods.name: indexModel
methods.description: Indexes a context's pages, actions, events, and resources for quick reference.

methods.name: mergeActionsAndUpdateTiming
methods.description: Merges actions from multiple contexts, aligning their timing and ensuring unique IDs across trace files.

methods.name: makeCallIdsUniqueAcrossTraceFiles
methods.description: Prefixes call and parent IDs with trace file identifiers to ensure uniqueness across multiple trace files.

methods.name: mergeActionsAndUpdateTimingSameTrace
methods.description: Merges actions within the same trace, aligning their timing between library and test runner contexts.

methods.name: adjustMonotonicTime
methods.description: Adjusts timing of actions and events by a specified delta to synchronize different timing sources.

methods.name: monotonicTimeDeltaBetweenLibraryAndRunner
methods.description: Calculates the time delta between library and test runner contexts based on shared actions.

methods.name: buildActionTree
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical tree of actions based on parent-child relationships.

methods.name: context
methods.description: Retrieves the context associated with a given action or event.

methods.name: nextInContext
methods.description: Gets the next action in the same context.

methods.name: previousActionByEndTime
methods.description: Gets the previous action based on end time.

methods.name: nextActionByStartTime
methods.description: Gets the next action based on start time.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Calculates error and warning counts for a given action.

methods.name: eventsForAction
methods.description: Retrieves events associated with a specific action.

methods.name: collectSources
methods.description: Collects source code snippets and error information related to actions.
